projects.name: pi
projects.description: AI agent toolkit: unified LLM API, agent loop, TUI, coding agent CLI
projects.summary_zh: 生产级跨平台 AI Agent 工具箱 | 模块化与工程化基线优秀
projects.summary_en: Production-grade cross-platform AI agent toolkit with excellent modularity and engineering practices
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合需要跨平台部署与深度扩展的团队
projects.recommendation_en: Recommended for teams requiring cross-platform deployment and deep extensibility
highlights_zh: 统一 LLM、Agent、TUI 与编码代理分层清晰，类型化 SDK 和扩展机制完整
CI、跨平台原生构建、发布冒烟测试、依赖锁定及离线模型数据形成可靠发布链
highlights_en: Clean separation across unified LLM APIs, agent runtime, TUI, and coding-agent packages
Strong release pipeline with CI, cross-platform native builds, smoke tests, dependency pinning, and offline model data
concerns_zh: 默认不具备文件系统、进程、网络及凭据隔离能力，生产部署需额外沙箱或容器化
Node.js 22.19+ 的运行时门槛较高，部分工具仍依赖系统安装的 fd 与 ripgrep
concerns_en: No built-in filesystem, process, network, or credential isolation, requiring sandboxing or containers in production
The Node.js 22.19+ requirement is relatively strict, and some tools still rely on system-installed fd and ripgrep

projects.name: herdr
projects.description: the runtime your coding agents live on
projects.summary_zh: 生产级跨平台智能体终端运行时，工程基线完善且扩展能力突出
projects.summary_en: Production-grade cross-platform agent terminal runtime with a strong engineering baseline and excellent extensibility
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合生产采用，建议先审计核心运行时与插件安全模型
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for production use after auditing core runtime and plugin security
highlights_zh: CI覆盖Linux、macOS与Windows，并配套格式检查、Clippy、测试及制品校验
提供Socket API、插件机制、智能体适配清单与完整中英文文档体系
highlights_en: CI covers Linux, macOS, and Windows with formatting, Clippy, tests, and artifact validation
Provides a socket API, plugin system, agent integration manifests, and comprehensive bilingual documentation
concerns_zh: 本次样本缺少核心Rust实现，无法核实错误处理、并发安全及测试覆盖深度
内置vendor补丁与定制ghostty-vt构建链会增加升级和供应链维护成本
concerns_en: The sample omits core Rust implementation, limiting verification of error handling, concurrency safety, and test depth
Vendored patches and the custom ghostty-vt build chain increase upgrade and supply-chain maintenance costs

projects.name: Codewhale
projects.description: An open-source coding agent for your terminal, written in Rust. It works with any model, can split one task across several agents, and every line of it is yours to read.
projects.summary_zh: 生产级模块化多模型终端智能体 | 跨平台交付与工程治理完备
projects.summary_en: Production-grade modular terminal agent with broad portability and mature engineering governance
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合团队生产部署，建议先做安全与兼容性验证
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for production adoption after focused security and compatibility validation
highlights_zh: Rust 工作区按协议、引擎、沙箱、工具与界面等职责拆分，边界清晰
提供 CI、依赖审计、发布校验、缓存治理及多架构容器构建
支持 Linux、macOS、Windows 与 ARM64，提供 Rustls 和无 C 编译器构建路径
highlights_en: The Rust workspace has clear responsibility boundaries across protocols, engine, sandbox, tools, and UI crates
CI, dependency auditing, release validation, cache governance, and multi-architecture container builds are present
Linux, macOS, Windows, and ARM64 are supported, including Rustls and compiler-free build paths
concerns_zh: cargo-deny 对安全公告检查允许失败，存在已知漏洞未阻断构建的风险
工作区规模较大且发布流程依赖多个外部令牌与人工触发，需重点验证供应链边界
concerns_en: cargo-deny permits advisory-check failures, allowing known vulnerabilities to pass the dependency gate
The large workspace and release process depend on multiple external tokens and manual triggers, requiring strong supply-chain validation

projects.name: codeshell
projects.description: An open-source AI coding assistant for your terminal, inspired by Claude Code. Interact with your codebase directly from the command line.
projects.summary_zh: 生产级多端 AI 编排框架 | 模块化与发布体系完善
projects.summary_en: Production-grade multi-surface AI orchestration framework with strong modularity and release engineering
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合生产集成，建议先验证核心场景稳定性
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for production integration after validating core workload stability
highlights_zh: 核心引擎与编码能力物理分包，并提供 CLI、SDK、桌面端统一运行时
CI 覆盖权限安全、SSRF、会话隔离、类型检查及真实发布烟测
highlights_en: Separates the domain-agnostic engine from coding capabilities while sharing one runtime across CLI, SDK, and desktop
CI covers permission safety, SSRF, session isolation, type checking, and realistic release smoke tests
concerns_zh: README 标注 0.9.x，而包版本为 0.11.0-rc.2，版本信息存在漂移
实现源码样本有限，核心模块内部质量仍需结合单测覆盖和运行数据验证
concerns_en: The README still states 0.9.x while package metadata is 0.11.0-rc.2, indicating version-information drift
Limited implementation samples leave core-module quality dependent on test coverage and production runtime evidence

projects.name: squarebox
projects.description: A curated set of modern CLI/TUI tools and AI coding assistants in a container. Batteries included.
projects.summary_zh: 生产级容器化开发工具箱 | 构建可信、跨平台且可持续演进
projects.summary_en: Production-grade containerized toolbox with trustworthy builds, broad portability, and sustainable evolution
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合重视可复现与跨平台研发环境的团队
projects.recommendation_en: Recommended for teams prioritizing reproducible, cross-platform development environments
highlights_zh: 工具版本、校验和及固定签名密钥均受控，镜像构建具备供应链验证与SBOM证明
提供 Bash、PowerShell、Podman、多架构构建及完整自动化测试，跨平台覆盖充分
highlights_en: Pinned versions, checksums, fixed signing keys, supply-chain verification, and SBOM provenance strengthen build integrity
Bash, PowerShell, Podman, multi-architecture builds, and comprehensive automated tests provide strong platform coverage
concerns_zh: 核心逻辑仍以 Shell 为主，复杂状态与错误路径的长期演进成本较高
默认安装命令采用远程脚本管道执行，且环境示例默认引用可变 latest 标签
concerns_en: Shell remains the core implementation language, increasing long-term maintenance costs for complex state and error paths
The default installer pipes a remote script into a shell, and the example environment references the mutable latest tag

projects.name: superagent
projects.description: An interactive, terminal-based AI coding assistant featuring a cyberpunk style terminal UI, context token tracking, and subagent orchestration.
projects.summary_zh: 生产导向的多端 AI 终端代理 | 可靠性与发布治理基线优秀
projects.summary_en: Production-oriented multi-platform AI terminal agent with strong reliability and release governance
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合开发团队试用，生产接入前需完成签名与稳定性验证
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for developer trials; complete signing and stability validation before production adoption
highlights_zh: CI覆盖构建、单元、集成、端到端、运行时及跨平台回归，并严格锁定依赖
具备发布产物溯源、校验和验证、灾难恢复演练及核心生命周期治理机制
highlights_en: CI covers build, unit, integration, end-to-end, runtime, and cross-platform regression gates with locked dependencies
Release provenance, checksum validation, disaster-recovery drills, and core lifecycle governance are extensively automated
concerns_zh: 当前仍以预发布版本为主，部分安装包未签名，且项目对 Bun、特定平台原生依赖及发布流水线耦合较深
concerns_en: The project remains prerelease-oriented, some installers are unsigned, and runtime behavior is tightly coupled to Bun, platform-native dependencies, and release infrastructure

projects.name: zeroclaw
projects.description: Fast, small, and fully autonomous AI personal assistant infrastructure, any OS, any platform — deploy anywhere, swap anything 🦀
projects.summary_zh: 生产级模块化AI代理运行时 | 跨平台与插件生态完备
projects.summary_en: Production-grade modular AI agent runtime with broad cross-platform and plugin support
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合自托管部署，建议先评估插件供应链风险
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for self-hosting after reviewing plugin supply-chain risks
highlights_zh: 工作区按API、运行时、渠道、工具和插件分层，职责边界清晰
CI覆盖发布漂移、跨平台构建、插件制品及包管理器新鲜度
highlights_en: The workspace cleanly separates API, runtime, channel, tool, and plugin responsibilities
CI covers release drift, cross-platform builds, plugin artifacts, and package freshness
concerns_zh: 工作区规模庞大且包含大量测试夹具与生成制品，长期演进复杂度较高
部分容器基础镜像仍未固定摘要，供应链一致性存在缺口
concerns_en: The large workspace, test fixtures, and generated artifacts create substantial long-term evolution complexity
Some container base images remain unpinned by digest, leaving a supply-chain consistency gap

projects.name: hermes-agent
projects.description: The agent that grows with you
projects.summary_zh: 生产级多渠道自进化智能体 | 跨平台与供应链治理基线优秀
projects.summary_en: Production-grade multi-channel self-improving agent with strong portability and supply-chain discipline

projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for production deployment; add independent security auditing
highlights_zh: 多提供商、插件化工具与六类终端后端形成清晰扩展边界
依赖精确锁定、工具链制品校验及57个工作流支撑长期演进
highlights_en: Clear extension boundaries across providers, pluggable tools, and six terminal backends
Exact dependency locking, verified toolchain artifacts, and 57 workflows support long-term evolution

安装脚本采用远程管道直接执行，且Python包版本与Node包版本口径不一致
concerns_en: Core Python implementation and tests were not included, so code-quality findings rely mainly on configuration and documentation evidence
Install scripts execute remote pipelines directly, and Python and Node package versions are not consistently represented

projects.name: openclaw
projects.description: The AI that really does things. Any OS. Any Platform. The lobster way. 🦞

projects.summary_en: Production-grade cross-platform AI assistant with strong supply-chain and release governance

发布流程包含签名、证明校验、精确提交验证、最小权限与失败证据留存
highlights_en: Digest-pinned multi-stage builds with explicit dependency and artifact boundaries
Release workflows enforce attestations, exact revisions, least privilege, and failure evidence

样本未覆盖核心 TypeScript 模块及其测试，无法充分评估运行时业务代码质量

The sample omits core TypeScript modules and their tests, limiting runtime code assessment

projects.name: openclaw
projects.description: Your own personal AI assistant. Any OS. Any Platform. The lobster way. 🦞
projects.summary_zh: 生产级跨平台AI助手基础设施 | 稳健且可扩展的发布基线
projects.summary_en: Production-grade cross-platform AI assistant infrastructure with a robust, extensible release baseline
projects.recommendation_zh: 推荐用于多平台部署与持续集成场景

发布流程实施最小权限、精确SHA校验、制品证明与失败证据留存

Release flows enforce least privilege, exact-SHA validation, artifact attestation, and failure-proof retention

Android发布流程参数与证明链较复杂，后续变更可能增加维护与审计成本
concerns_en: The sample is dominated by workflows and build configuration, with limited evidence for core TypeScript implementation and test coverage
The Android release workflow has a complex parameter and attestation chain that may increase maintenance and audit costs

projects.name: cline
projects.description: Autonomous coding agent as an SDK, IDE extension, or CLI assistant.
projects.summary_zh: 生产级多形态AI编码代理 | 共享SDK驱动、测试发布体系完善
projects.summary_en: Production-grade multi-platform coding agent with a shared SDK and mature testing and release infrastructure
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合生产集成，建议先验证Bun兼容与平台覆盖
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for production integration after validating Bun compatibility and platform coverage
highlights_zh: 工作区按SDK、CLI、IDE扩展和桌面端分层，核心能力可复用且边界清晰
具备Biome、类型检查、单元测试、端到端测试及多平台发布校验
highlights_en: Clear workspace separation across the SDK, CLI, IDE extensions, and desktop app enables broad core reuse
Comprehensive Biome, typecheck, unit, end-to-end, and multi-platform release validation

新旧VS Code扩展并行发布及JetBrains未开源，增加维护和迁移复杂度
concerns_en: Builds and scripts strongly depend on Bun 1.4.2 and use bash or zsh in places, limiting cross-environment reproducibility
Concurrent legacy and SDK-based VS Code release pipelines plus the closed-source JetBrains client add migration and maintenance complexity

projects.name: agentic-awesome-skills

projects.summary_zh: 生产级多平台 Agent 技能目录与分发平台 | 交付链路成熟
projects.summary_en: Production-grade multi-platform agent skill catalog and distribution platform with a mature delivery pipeline
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合生产试用，发布前抽查技能内容质量
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for production trials after spot-checking skill content quality

发布流程使用不可变候选包、精确版本校验、跨平台功能测试及受限权限
highlights_en: Comprehensive quality gates cover validation, auditing, reference checks, warning budgets, and consistency checks
Release delivery uses immutable candidate artifacts, exact version verification, cross-platform tests, and least-privilege permissions
concerns_zh: Node、Python、Bash与Shell脚本混合且编排脚本较多，增加了维护与跨平台排障复杂度
concerns_en: The mix of Node.js, Python, Bash, and shell scripts, together with extensive orchestration, increases maintenance and cross-platform troubleshooting complexity

projects.name: qwen-code
projects.description: An open-source AI coding agent that lives in your terminal.
projects.summary_zh: 生产级多端 AI 编程代理 | 工程治理与扩展能力突出
projects.summary_en: Production-grade multi-channel AI coding agent with strong engineering governance and extensibility
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合生产采用，建议先审计核心代理与权限边界

Supports multiple model protocols, MCP, SDKs, and chat channels through clear extension boundaries

Several GitHub Actions files are exceptionally large, increasing automation maintenance and supply-chain governance costs

projects.summary_en: Large-scale multi-agent skill library with strong CI governance and cross-platform compatibility
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合规模化采用，建议接入前验证脚本与内容质量

CI覆盖语法、清单、版本、安全、文档和跨工具真实安装验证
highlights_en: Uses standardized skill packages and plugin manifests across more than ten agent harnesses
CI validates syntax, manifests, versions, security, documentation, and clean harness installs
concerns_zh: 工作流存在豁免项且部分模式校验与自动审查采用非阻断策略
项目规模庞大，内容质量与脚本正确性仍需依赖逐项测试和持续维护
concerns_en: Some workflow schema checks and automated reviews are configured non-blocking or excluded
At this scale, content quality and script correctness still depend on comprehensive testing and ongoing maintenance

projects.name: laoHuangCode
projects.description: Open-source terminal AI coding assistant with multi-provider support, MCP integration, and session management.
projects.summary_zh: 生产级跨平台终端 AI 编程助手 | 发布与容错体系完善
projects.summary_en: Production-grade cross-platform terminal AI coding assistant with mature release and recovery workflows
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合个人开发与团队试用，敏感环境需加强沙箱
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for developers and team trials; add stronger sandboxing for sensitive environments
highlights_zh: 严格 TypeScript、领域化工作区与明确的工程规范支撑可维护性
覆盖六平台独立发行、校验和、原子更新、失败恢复及多平台 CI
highlights_en: Strict TypeScript, domain-oriented workspaces, and explicit engineering rules improve maintainability
Six-platform distribution includes checksum verification, atomic updates, failure recovery, and CI validation

PR CI 主要覆盖 Ubuntu，发布流程还会跳过独立安装器的完整验收

PR CI mainly targets Ubuntu, and the release flow skips full standalone installer validation

projects.recommendation_zh: 适合边缘部署，生产接入前需审计安全边界

projects.name: oh-my-pi

The small contributor base and unpinned CI tool versions leave release reproducibility risks

projects.name: spacebot

Broad integration surface spanning Discord, Slack, Telegram, Twitch, MCP, and multiple model providers

FSL-1.1-ALv2 is not a standard OSI-approved open-source license and requires commercial review

projects.name: ironclaw
projects.description: IronClaw is an Agent OS focused on privacy, security and extensibility
projects.summary_zh: 安全优先、模块化且工程化成熟的可扩展个人AI代理操作系统
projects.summary_en: A security-first, modular and extensible personal AI agent operating system
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合重视安全、扩展与自托管的团队
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for teams prioritizing security, extensibility and self-hosting

Defense in depth through WASM isolation, permissions, credential guarding and endpoint allowlists
Tiered CI with impact analysis, merge-queue gates and hermetic deterministic testing

README标注Rust 1.85+，而工作区实际要求Rust 1.96，版本说明存在不一致

concerns_en: Reliance on PostgreSQL 15 and pgvector raises the infrastructure deployment threshold
The README states Rust 1.85+ while the workspace requires Rust 1.96, indicating inconsistent version documentation
The sample primarily contains documentation and build configuration, limiting verification of core Rust error handling and runtime implementation quality

当前CI未执行Docker镜像构建与容器内启动验证

The current CI pipeline does not build or validate startup of the Docker image

projects.name: openfang

The Docker runtime includes full Rust, Python, Node, and npm environments and runs as root, weakening image size, attack-surface, and least-privilege baselines

projects.name: zclaw

projects.name: localclaw

依赖规模较大且存在临时版本上限，升级维护成本较高
concerns_en: CodeQL is currently non-blocking and does not yet enforce a mandatory security gate
The large dependency set and temporary version ceilings create ongoing upgrade and maintenance overhead

projects.name: openclaw
projects.description: Your own personal AI assistant. Any OS. Any Platform. The lobster way. 🦞
projects.summary_zh: 准生产级多渠道 AI 网关 | 扩展能力强，发布与依赖治理仍需加强
projects.summary_en: Near-production multi-channel AI gateway with strong extensibility but room for stronger release and dependency governance
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合生产部署，核心场景建议先行试点
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for production trials, starting with core use cases
highlights_zh: 提供细粒度 Plugin SDK、插件入口及类型声明，扩展边界清晰
采用冻结锁文件、分片测试、超时控制、构建重试及固定镜像摘要
highlights_en: Provides a granular Plugin SDK, plugin entry points, and type declarations
Uses frozen lockfiles, sharded tests, timeouts, retries, and pinned image digests
concerns_zh: A2UI 构建失败时会生成桩文件，可能将构建问题推迟到运行阶段
Python Ruff 仅启用少量严重规则，镜像构建仍依赖在线安装脚本
concerns_en: A2UI build failures fall back to a stub, potentially deferring failures to runtime
Python Ruff enables only a narrow set of checks, while image builds rely on remote install scripts

projects.name: EdgeClaw
projects.description: EdgeClaw: Edge-Cloud Collaborative Personal AI Assistant based on OpenClaw
projects.summary_zh: 端云协同智能体平台 | 插件化与安全基线良好
projects.summary_en: Edge-cloud agent platform with strong extensibility and a solid security baseline
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合生产试点，部署前需验证安全和跨平台兼容性
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for production trials after security and cross-platform validation
highlights_zh: 采用多阶段构建、依赖锁定、镜像摘要固定及非root沙箱用户
扩展按记忆、路由、治理、沙箱和技能发现等能力解耦，集成边界清晰
highlights_en: Uses multi-stage builds, locked dependencies, pinned image digests, and non-root sandbox users
Separates memory, routing, governance, sandboxing, and skill discovery into well-scoped extensions
concerns_zh: 样本缺少核心TypeScript实现，无法充分验证业务代码质量与错误处理
构建阶段在线安装Bun、Homebrew等工具且存在跨架构降级桩，供应链与可重复性仍有风险
TypeScript主项目混有Python技能测试与工具链，且尚无正式发布版本
concerns_en: Core TypeScript implementation is absent from the sample, limiting verification of business logic and error handling
Online installation of Bun and Homebrew plus cross-architecture fallback stubs leaves supply-chain and reproducibility risks
The TypeScript-led project mixes in Python skill tooling and has no formal release yet

projects.name: picoclaw
projects.description: Ultra-lightweight, open-source, self-hosted personal AI assistant in Go for RISC-V, SBCs, and embedded systems. Active PicoClaw fork with WebUI, MCP, memory, multi-agent workflows, plugins, and chat apps.
projects.summary_zh: 轻量跨平台边缘 AI 助手，工程基线扎实但缺少运行时源码样本
projects.summary_en: Lightweight cross-platform edge AI assistant with a strong engineering baseline but limited runtime source evidence
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合边缘部署选型，落地前审计核心服务代码
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for edge deployment, subject to core-service code review
highlights_zh: CI 覆盖静态检查、漏洞扫描、单元测试、集成测试与前端验证
支持多架构交叉构建及容器多平台发布，覆盖主流嵌入式平台
highlights_en: CI covers linting, vulnerability scanning, unit and integration tests, and frontend validation
Cross-architecture builds and multi-platform containers support major embedded targets
concerns_zh: 样本主要是 README 与工作流，缺少核心 Go 实现、错误处理和并发模型证据
发布流程依赖多项外部密钥与平台变量，失败路径和凭据治理仍需核验
concerns_en: The sample contains mostly documentation and workflows, with limited evidence for core Go error handling and concurrency
Release automation depends on external secrets and platform variables, requiring further validation of failure paths and credential governance

projects.name: swarmvault
projects.description: The local-first LLM Wiki: open-source knowledge graph builder, RAG knowledge base, and agent memory store. Built on Andrej Karpathy's pattern. An Obsidian alternative for personal knowledge management, AI second brain, and durable Claude Code / Codex / OpenClaw memory.
projects.summary_zh: 生产级本地优先知识图谱工具链 | 模块化与可持续交付基线扎实
projects.summary_en: Production-grade local-first knowledge graph toolchain with a solid modular and sustainable delivery baseline
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合个人与团队知识管理，可进入试点
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for personal and team knowledge management; proceed with a controlled pilot
highlights_zh: CLI、引擎与查看器分层清晰，并配置类型检查、分层测试及性能预算
支持离线启发式提供方、容器化 MCP 服务及发布后多提供商冒烟测试
highlights_en: Clear separation across CLI, engine, and viewer, backed by type checking, layered tests, and performance budgets
Offers an offline heuristic provider, containerized MCP service, and post-release multi-provider smoke testing
concerns_zh: 要求 Node.js 24，运行环境兼容性弱于支持更广泛 Node LTS 版本的工具
仅显示两名贡献者，存在维护人员集中与知识传承风险
concerns_en: Requires Node.js 24, limiting runtime compatibility compared with tools supporting a wider range of Node LTS releases
Only two contributors are indicated, creating maintainer concentration and knowledge-transfer risk

projects.name: push
projects.description: A secure, stable, and lightweight alternative to OpenClaw and Hermes.
projects.summary_zh: 轻量本地 Rust 助手网关 | 工程化完整但生态仍处早期
projects.summary_en: Lightweight local Rust assistant gateway with solid engineering foundations
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合个人自托管试点，团队生产使用前需补充安全与集成验证
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for personal self-hosting; validate security and integrations before team production use
highlights_zh: 模块边界清晰，通道、代理后端、存储与调度职责隔离
具备锁定依赖、Clippy、测试、文档构建、RustSec 审计与双平台发布流程
highlights_en: Clear module boundaries separate channels, agent backends, storage, and scheduling
Uses locked dependencies, Clippy, tests, strict docs builds, RustSec audits, and dual-platform releases
concerns_zh: 贡献者规模较小，且当前样本未展示核心源码与测试覆盖率
仅支持 macOS/Linux，iMessage 进一步依赖 macOS，跨平台能力受限
配置中直接保存 Telegram bot token，敏感凭据管理仍有加强空间
concerns_en: Small contributor base and the provided sample does not expose core implementation details or test coverage
Support is limited to macOS and Linux, while iMessage additionally requires macOS
Telegram bot tokens are stored directly in configuration, leaving room for stronger secret management

projects.name: OpenSuperBot
projects.description: Self-hosted AI teammates, each with its own computer — a Grok Bot alternative on your hardware. Bring any model. Unofficial.
projects.summary_zh: 跨平台自托管 AI 团队平台 | 工程化完善但核心实现待审
projects.summary_en: Cross-platform self-hosted AI teammate platform with a strong engineering baseline, pending core implementation review
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合试点采用，投产前需审计安全与核心实现
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for pilots; audit security and core code before production
highlights_zh: CI覆盖类型检查、测试、构建、依赖审计及真实浏览器冒烟测试
同时支持Docker与本机模式，并适配macOS、Linux和Windows
highlights_en: CI covers type checking, tests, builds, dependency audits, and real-browser smoke tests
Supports both Docker and local modes across macOS, Linux, and Windows
concerns_zh: 源码样本缺少核心业务实现，无法验证错误处理、权限边界与数据一致性
本机模式缺少容器资源隔离，macOS安装包尚未完成Apple公证
concerns_en: The sample omits core implementation, preventing validation of error handling, permission boundaries, and data consistency
Local mode lacks container-level resource isolation, and the macOS package is not yet notarized

projects.name: agents
projects.description: Plugins, agents, skills, and commands for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, OpenCode, Antigravity CLI, GitHub Copilot, and Pi, written once in Markdown and adapted to each tool by generators with validation and evals.
projects.summary_zh: 多工具代理内容生态与生成适配平台 | 工程质量基线扎实
projects.summary_en: Multi-harness agent content ecosystem and generator platform with a solid engineering baseline
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合多工具团队采用，生成与评测需持续完善
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for multi-tool teams, with continued investment in generation and evaluation
highlights_zh: 采用单一 Markdown 事实源，并通过适配器生成七种工具格式，降低内容重复维护成本
具备生成物校验、严格校验、命名冲突检查、版本检查、格式检查和多工具 CLI 验证等完整 CI 门禁
使用 ruff、ty、pytest、Markdown/JSON/TOML/YAML 校验及定期评测报告，工程化程度较高
highlights_en: Uses a single Markdown source of truth with adapters that generate formats for seven harnesses
Provides CI gates for generated artifacts, strict validation, naming collisions, versioning, formatting, and multi-harness CLI execution
Combines ruff, ty, pytest, structured-file validation, and scheduled evaluation reports
concerns_zh: LLM judge 与 Monte Carlo 评测仍是实验性质，缺少人工标注校准，不能直接证明任务成功率
项目仍依赖多个外部 CLI、Python 包和特定运行环境，跨平台安装体验可能存在差异
concerns_en: LLM judge and Monte Carlo evaluations remain experimental and lack human-label calibration
Reliance on multiple external CLIs, Python packages, and platform-specific runtimes may affect cross-platform installation

projects.name: kilocode
projects.description: Kilo is the all-in-one agentic engineering platform. Build, ship, and iterate faster with the most popular open source coding agent.
projects.summary_zh: 生产级多端 AI 编程平台 | 工程治理完善但迁移维护成本较高
projects.summary_en: Production-grade multi-platform AI coding platform with strong engineering governance but elevated migration overhead
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合团队采用，需评估 v2 迁移与供应链风险
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for team adoption after reviewing v2 migration and supply-chain risks
highlights_zh: 具备类型检查、架构检查、重复代码检测及分层测试脚本
CI 权限最小化，并针对不可信 PR 明确隔离代码执行与凭据
highlights_en: Provides type checking, architecture checks, duplication detection, and layered test scripts
Uses least-privilege CI permissions and explicitly isolates code execution and credentials from untrusted PRs
concerns_zh: main 与 v2 并行迁移及 opencode 定制分叉增加长期维护与重复修复成本
根目录测试命令主动失败，测试入口分散且开发者上手成本较高
concerns_en: Parallel main/v2 migration and opencode customization forks increase long-term maintenance and duplicate-fix costs
The root test command intentionally fails while test entry points remain fragmented across packages

projects.name: ygrep
projects.description: A fast, local, indexed code search tool optimized for AI coding assistants. Written in Rust using Tantivy for full-text indexing.
projects.summary_zh: 面向AI编码助手的本地索引化代码搜索工具，工程化成熟且跨平台支持完善
projects.summary_en: A production-oriented local indexed code search tool for AI coding assistants with strong cross-platform engineering
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合AI编码助手，建议先纳入团队试点
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for AI coding assistants; pilot it within a team first
highlights_zh: 采用Rust工作区并拆分核心库与CLI模块，配合格式检查、Clippy和测试CI
发布流程覆盖多平台及多种CPU架构，并提供可选语义搜索以降低原生依赖
highlights_en: Uses a Rust workspace with separated core and CLI crates, backed by formatting, Clippy, and test CI
The release pipeline covers multiple platforms and CPU targets while keeping semantic search optional
concerns_zh: Cargo.lock被忽略，不利于命令行应用构建的可复现性；CI目前仅在Ubuntu执行完整测试
concerns_en: Cargo.lock is ignored, weakening reproducibility for a CLI application, and CI currently runs the full test suite only on Ubuntu

projects.name: nanobot
projects.description: Your lightweight open-source personal agent.
projects.summary_zh: 工程化程度较高的轻量级多渠道个人智能体框架 | 供应链与跨平台能力完善
projects.summary_en: A well-engineered lightweight multi-channel personal agent with strong supply-chain and cross-platform practices
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合自托管部署，生产使用前需完成安全与兼容性验收
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for self-hosting after production security and compatibility validation
highlights_zh: CI覆盖Python 3.11至3.14及Linux、Windows，并包含依赖一致性和原生安装验收
发布流程具备Sigstore签名、精确制品校验、审批隔离与最小权限控制
highlights_en: CI covers Python 3.11–3.14 on Linux and Windows, including dependency and native-package acceptance checks
The release pipeline uses Sigstore signing, exact-artifact verification, approval separation, and least-privilege controls
concerns_zh: 项目仍标记为Alpha，且核心依赖较多，与“轻量级”定位存在一定张力
部分平台敏感测试在常规CI中被忽略，扩展性及多通道兼容性仍需更多真实环境验证
concerns_en: The project is still marked Alpha and carries a broad dependency set that may conflict with its lightweight positioning
Some platform-sensitive tests are excluded from routine CI, leaving additional real-environment validation necessary

projects.name: ClawX
projects.description: ClawX is a desktop app that provides a graphical interface for OpenClaw AI agents. It turns CLI-based AI orchestration into a desktop experience without using the terminal. China website is https://clawx.com.cn.
projects.summary_zh: 跨平台桌面级 AI 客户端 | 工程化与持续交付基线扎实
projects.summary_en: Cross-platform desktop AI client with a solid engineering and delivery baseline
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合快速选型，建议先做安全与稳定性验证
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for rapid adoption; validate security and stability first
highlights_zh: CI覆盖 lint、类型检查、单元测试及多平台 Electron E2E
提供 Windows、macOS、Linux 打包与独立平台构建脚本
highlights_en: CI covers linting, type checks, unit tests, and multi-platform Electron E2E
Provides dedicated Windows, macOS, and Linux packaging workflows
concerns_zh: 源码样本未包含核心业务实现，模块边界、错误处理与依赖治理难以充分验证
构建链路依赖多项外部二进制下载、OpenClaw 打包及运行时集成，供应链与环境一致性风险需额外审查
concerns_en: The sample omits core implementation, limiting verification of module boundaries, error handling, and dependency governance
The build relies on external binary downloads, OpenClaw bundling, and runtime integration, requiring additional supply-chain and environment consistency review

projects.name: troublemaker
projects.description: Multiplatform AI agent runtime.
projects.summary_zh: 工程化程度较高的多平台 AI 智能体运行时 | 适合试点与二次开发
projects.summary_en: A well-engineered multi-platform AI agent runtime suited for pilots and extension
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合试点，生产部署前需完善发布与供应链固定
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for pilots; formal releases and supply-chain pinning are needed for production
highlights_zh: 统一网关、宿主与边缘模式边界清晰，并通过独立导出入口支持多场景集成
安全与平台适配测试覆盖面广，包含入口鉴权、XSS、令牌文件及协议级回归测试
具备类型检查、构建产物检查、秘密扫描和固定版本的包管理器与 CI 配置
highlights_en: Clear separation between the unified gateway, host mode, and edge mode with dedicated public exports
Broad security and adapter coverage, including ingress authorization, XSS, protected token files, and protocol regressions
Type checking, package checks, secret scanning, and pinned package-manager and CI configuration
concerns_zh: 项目仍处于 0.1.0 且暂无正式发布，公共 API 与兼容性承诺尚不明确
Docker 构建默认克隆仓库最新分支，版本参数未实际锁定提交，供应链可复现性不足
构建依赖 Node 22、pnpm、Linux 系统包及部分 macOS 专用脚本，跨平台能力不均衡
concerns_en: The project remains at 0.1.0 with no formal release, so its public API and compatibility guarantees are unclear
The Docker build clones the repository default branch while version arguments do not pin a commit, weakening build reproducibility
The build depends on Node 22, pnpm, Linux system packages, and some macOS-specific scripts, limiting platform parity

projects.name: clawdroid
projects.description: Android AI assistant with an embedded Go backend. Install the APK, launch, and start chatting — no separate server setup needed.
projects.summary_zh: 工程化较完整的跨平台嵌入式 Android AI 助手
projects.summary_en: A well-engineered cross-platform Android AI assistant with an embedded backend
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合试点，生产部署前强化安全与并发测试
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for pilots; strengthen security and concurrency testing before production
highlights_zh: 格式检查、静态分析、vet与单元测试已纳入PR门禁
支持多架构APK、Termux及Go多平台构建
highlights_en: PR gates cover formatting, linting, vet, and unit tests
Supports multi-ABI APKs, Termux, and multi-platform Go builds
concerns_zh: WebSocket默认空allow_from意味着允许所有来源访问
CI缺少竞态检测、依赖漏洞扫描与核心Go覆盖率门槛
样本未展示核心Go实现，安全边界与错误恢复仍需核验
concerns_en: An empty WebSocket allow_from list permits every source by default
CI lacks race detection, dependency vulnerability scanning, and a core Go coverage threshold
Core Go implementation is absent from the sample, leaving security boundaries and recovery behavior unverified

projects.name: nanoclaw
projects.description: A lightweight alternative to OpenClaw that runs in containers for security. Connects to WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord, Gmail and other messaging apps,, has memory, scheduled jobs, and runs directly on Anthropic's Agents SDK
projects.summary_zh: 轻量容器化个人智能体平台 | 隔离清晰、扩展灵活但平台依赖较强
projects.summary_en: Lightweight containerized personal agent platform with clear isolation and flexible extensions, albeit with notable platform dependencies
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合重视隔离与可定制的个人及小团队部署
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for individuals and small teams prioritizing isolation and customization
highlights_zh: 采用宿主路由、SQLite邮箱与独立容器分层，职责边界清晰
CI覆盖格式化、类型检查、分片测试及容器测试，并固定关键依赖版本
highlights_en: Clear separation across host routing, SQLite mailboxes, and isolated agent containers
CI covers formatting, type checking, sharded tests, container tests, and pinned dependency verification
concerns_zh: 安装与运行依赖Bash、Docker及Node 22+，原生Windows支持有限
渠道和提供商分散在独立分支并复制进用户Fork，长期存在版本漂移与维护成本
concerns_en: Installation and runtime depend on Bash, Docker, and Node 22+, limiting native Windows support
Channels and providers live in separate branches and are copied into forks, creating long-term version-drift and maintenance costs

projects.name: Patter
projects.description: Open-source voice-AI SDK. The Vapi/Retell alternative for builders who want to own the stack. Give your AI agent a phone number in 4 lines — Python and TypeScript, MIT licensed, Twilio, Telnyx, and Plivo.
projects.summary_zh: 生产级多供应商语音 SDK | 扩展与交付体系完善但安全门禁偏弱
projects.summary_en: Production-grade multi-provider voice SDK with strong extensibility and delivery tooling, but weak security enforcement
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合自托管语音应用，投产前强化安全门禁
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for self-hosted voice applications; enforce security gates before production use.
highlights_zh: Python 与 TypeScript 双 SDK 对齐，支持 LLM、语音及运营商统一替换
具备依赖审计、静态分析、文档漂移检测、自动化发布与分支治理
highlights_en: Parity Python and TypeScript SDKs with replaceable LLM, speech, and carrier providers
Includes dependency auditing, static analysis, documentation drift checks, automated releases, and branch governance
concerns_zh: pip-audit、npm audit 和 Bandit 均忽略失败，安全问题不会阻止合并
分支清理仅判断存在已合并 PR，未严格限定目标分支为 main 或 develop
concerns_en: pip-audit, npm audit, and Bandit failures are ignored, so security findings do not block merging
Branch cleanup checks for any merged PR without strictly limiting the target base to main or develop

projects.name: career-ops
projects.description: Open-source AI job search agent and job finder: scan job boards, score each job 1-5 against your CV before you apply, tailor an ATS-friendly resume and cover letter, get interview prep and an application tracker. It helps you fill in each application; you press Submit. Runs locally in Codex, OpenCode and other AI CLIs, or as a Claude Code plugin.
projects.summary_zh: 本地优先的跨 AI CLI 求职智能体 | 开放集成基线
projects.summary_en: Local-first AI job-search agent with a strong cross-CLI integration baseline
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合重视隐私与可扩展集成的团队
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for privacy-conscious teams seeking extensible integrations
highlights_zh: 支持 Codex、OpenCode、Claude Code 等多种本地 AI CLI，部署与迁移门槛低
提供多语言 README、插件式智能体能力及持续发布机制，社区与协作基础扎实
highlights_en: Runs locally across Codex, OpenCode, Claude Code, and other AI CLIs with low deployment friction
Provides multilingual documentation, plugin-oriented agent skills, and sustained release activity
concerns_zh: 当前源码样本仅包含 README，缺少核心 JavaScript 实现、自动化测试及错误处理证据
依赖多种 AI CLI 与外部职位来源，跨环境一致性和失败恢复能力尚无法验证
concerns_en: The provided source sample contains only README files, with no core JavaScript implementation, automated tests, or error-handling evidence
Reliance on multiple AI CLIs and external job sources leaves cross-environment consistency and failure recovery unverified

projects.name: claude-code-templates
projects.description: Open-source registry and CLI for Claude Code components: agents, commands, skills, hooks, MCPs, settings and mods
projects.summary_zh: 生产级多语言组件注册表与CLI | 安全审查和契约测试基线扎实
projects.summary_en: Production-grade multi-language component registry and CLI with a strong security and contract-testing baseline
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合采用，建议先评估发布流程与遥测隐私
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for adoption; review the publishing workflow and telemetry privacy first
