projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for personal trials; strengthen core services before production deployment
highlights_zh: 可选依赖按渠道与功能拆分，核心安装轻量且扩展边界清晰
配置 Ruff、pytest、多系统 CI 与可信发布流程，工程基线较完整
highlights_en: Dependencies are cleanly split by channel and feature, keeping the core install lightweight
Ruff, pytest, multi-OS CI, and trusted publishing provide a solid engineering baseline
concerns_zh: 项目仍标记为 Alpha，且 pyproject 版本与变更日志版本明显不一致
CI 未覆盖 Windows 和 Python 3.13，配置的 mypy 也未进入流水线
依赖仅设置下限且仓库未提供锁定文件，长期构建可复现性有限
concerns_en: The project remains Alpha, and the pyproject version conflicts with the changelog version
CI omits Windows and Python 3.13, while the configured mypy checks are not run
Dependencies have lower bounds only and no lockfile is provided, limiting long-term reproducibility

projects.name: ClawTeam-OpenClaw
projects.description: ClawTeam fork fully adapted for OpenClaw — multi-agent swarm coordination with OpenClaw as the default agent
projects.summary_zh: 文档驱动的跨平台多智能体编排工具 | 生产级演进中
projects.summary_en: Document-rich cross-platform multi-agent orchestrator with a production-oriented evolution path
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合试点，生产部署前需审查源码与测试
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for pilots; review source and tests before production deployment
highlights_zh: 兼容Windows、Linux与macOS，并提供tmux到subprocess的降级路径
支持任意CLI智能体及文件、ZeroMQ P2P等多传输后端
提供多语言文档、上游同步机制和CI/CD基础
highlights_en: Supports Windows, Linux, and macOS with a tmux-to-subprocess fallback
Works with arbitrary CLI agents and multiple transports including files and ZeroMQ P2P
Provides multilingual documentation, upstream synchronization, and CI/CD foundations
concerns_zh: 样本仅包含README，缺少核心实现、测试覆盖率及异常处理代码证据
中英文文档对tmux依赖和Windows回退的描述存在差异
仅3次发布且近期维护活跃度仍需观察
concerns_en: The sample contains only README files, with no implementation, test coverage, or exception-handling evidence
Chinese and English documentation differ on tmux requirements and Windows fallback behavior
Only three releases have been published, and recent maintenance activity remains to be observed

projects.name: downy
projects.description: OpenClaw Alternative - Create a team of agents and work with them from anywhere.
projects.summary_zh: 类型规范且多模型可扩展的 Cloudflare 多智能体平台 | 仍处于早期快速迭代阶段
projects.summary_en: A well-typed, extensible Cloudflare multi-agent platform still in rapid early-stage development
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合个人试验，暂不建议关键业务生产部署
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for personal trials, but not yet recommended for critical production workloads
highlights_zh: 启用严格 TypeScript、类型感知 lint、未使用代码检查及 Vitest 测试链路
支持 Workers AI、OpenRouter 与本地 Pi 代理，模型提供商扩展边界清晰
highlights_en: Enforces strict TypeScript, type-aware linting, dead-code checks, and a Vitest test pipeline
Supports Workers AI, OpenRouter, and a local Pi proxy through a clear provider abstraction
concerns_zh: 项目无自动化 CI、正式发布记录较少，且仅有两名贡献者，交付稳定性不足
README 明示自编辑功能存在提示注入风险，安全边界仍需系统性验证
运行环境高度依赖 Node 24、pnpm 与 Cloudflare，跨平台可移植性受限
concerns_en: No automated CI, limited release history, and only two contributors indicate delivery-stability risk
The README explicitly warns that self-editing features are vulnerable to prompt injection
Operation depends heavily on Node 24, pnpm, and Cloudflare, limiting cross-platform portability

projects.name: safestclaw
projects.description: Safestclaw is the alternative to openclaw.. You can naturally chat with it via text and voice, and you can choose not to use a language model., By default it picks up on intent and semantics..  No prompt injection while you get over ninety percent of what openclaw does plus tts and voice to text
projects.summary_zh: 隐私优先的模块化多渠道助手 | 工程基线良好但仍处 Alpha
projects.summary_en: Privacy-first modular multi-channel assistant with a solid engineering baseline but still alpha-stage
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合试用与二次开发，暂不建议直接用于关键生产场景
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for trials and secondary development, but not yet recommended for critical production use
highlights_zh: 采用可选依赖分组、插件体系及 MCP 接口，核心与重功能解耦
配置 Ruff、pytest、mypy，并通过双平台多版本 CI 验证
highlights_en: Optional dependency groups, plugins, and MCP keep the core decoupled from heavy features
Ruff, pytest, and mypy are configured, with multi-version CI on Linux and macOS
concerns_zh: 依赖仅设置最低版本且无锁文件，构建可复现性不足
CI 未执行类型检查、覆盖率门槛、依赖漏洞扫描及 Windows 测试
项目仍标记为 Alpha，版本与变更日志演进信息存在不一致
concerns_en: Dependencies use only lower bounds without lockfiles, reducing build reproducibility
CI omits type checking, coverage thresholds, dependency vulnerability scanning, and Windows tests
The project remains Alpha while its version and changelog history appear inconsistent

projects.name: Clawlet
projects.description: 🌸 A lightweight AI agent framework with identity awareness inspired by OpenClaw, aimed to be very simple to set up and easy to use, get up and running in 2 minutes.
projects.summary_zh: 轻量且易扩展的本地优先 AI 代理框架 | 原型友好、生产基线尚弱
projects.summary_en: A lightweight, extensible local-first AI agent framework suited to prototypes
highlights_zh: 统一工具注册表、最小权限工具集与按任务模型路由形成清晰的可扩展架构
采用 Hatchling、uv.lock、SQLite 和标准 CLI 入口，安装简单且跨环境部署门槛较低
highlights_en: A unified tool registry, least-privilege toolsets, and per-task model routing provide a clear extension architecture
Hatchling, uv.lock, SQLite, and a standard CLI entry point keep installation and deployment lightweight
concerns_zh: 项目仍处于 Alpha 阶段，发布次数少且仅有单一贡献者，维护连续性存在风险
CI 覆盖率仅报告不设阻断阈值，核心源码未包含在样本中，关键实现质量仍需代码审查
concerns_en: The project remains alpha-stage with one release and a single contributor, creating maintenance continuity risk
CI reports coverage without enforcing a threshold, while the provided sample omits core implementation code needed for deeper verification

projects.name: picobot
projects.description: A lightweight self-hosted bot in a single binary, written in Go.
projects.summary_zh: 轻量高可移植的自托管 AI 机器人 | 工程化完善但源码审计不足
projects.summary_en: Lightweight, highly portable self-hosted AI bot with solid engineering practices but limited source visibility
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合个人自托管，生产部署前需补充安全审计
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for personal self-hosting; complete a security review before production use
highlights_zh: 单二进制、无外部运行时，支持 Linux、macOS、ARM64 与 Docker 多架构构建
提供工具、记忆、技能及 MCP 扩展机制，并配置 lint、vet、测试和镜像发布流水线
highlights_en: Single-binary runtime with Linux, macOS, ARM64, and multi-architecture Docker support
Extensible tools, memory, skills, and MCP integrations backed by lint, vet, test, and image publishing workflows
concerns_zh: 样本未包含核心 Go 实现、单元测试及错误处理细节，无法充分验证健壮性和可维护性
执行命令、文件操作和网络访问等高权限能力缺少可见的安全边界与权限隔离说明
concerns_en: Core Go implementation, unit tests, and error-handling details are absent, limiting verification of robustness and maintainability
High-privilege command execution, filesystem access, and network access lack visible security-boundary and permission-isolation details

projects.name: openclawWeComzh
projects.description: Open-source implementation of the AEON Protocol for advanced AI cognitive observability, featuring real-time dialectic flow tracking, automated memory distillation (Auto-Seal), and knowledge aging visualization.
projects.summary_zh: 工程化成熟的多渠道 AI 网关，但仓库已迁移且项目定位存在明显偏差
projects.summary_en: Well-engineered multi-channel AI gateway, but with repository migration and metadata inconsistencies
projects.recommendation_zh: 优先评估上游新仓库，暂不建议长期采用
projects.recommendation_en: Prefer the maintained upstream and avoid long-term adoption here
highlights_zh: 提供插件 SDK、模块导出及多渠道边界检查，扩展结构较完整
具备格式、类型、Lint、死代码、文档和单元测试等自动化检查链
highlights_en: Provides a plugin SDK, modular exports, and channel-boundary checks
Includes automated formatting, typing, linting, dead-code, documentation, and test checks
concerns_zh: README 明确声明项目不再维护并迁移至 OpenAEON，持续维护能力不足
项目元数据描述 AEON 可观测性，但源码包和 README 实际定位为 OpenClaw 中文分支，信息不一致
工作流使用 pull_request_target 并授予写权限，增加供应链与自动化注入风险
一键安装采用 curl 管道执行脚本，且 Docker 默认启用 allow-unconfigured，部署安全边界需谨慎验证
concerns_en: The README explicitly marks the project as unmaintained and redirects users to OpenAEON
Project metadata describes AEON observability, while the package and README describe an OpenClaw Chinese distribution
The workflow grants write permissions to pull_request_target, increasing supply-chain and automation-injection risk
One-line installation pipes remote scripts into a shell, and the container enables allow-unconfigured by default

projects.name: DenchClaw
projects.description: Migrate to dench.com if you're reading this. Fully Managed OpenClaw Framework for all knowledge work ever. CRM Automation and Outreach agents. The only local productivity tool you need.
projects.summary_zh: 工程化较完整的本地AI CRM框架，扩展生态良好但部署复现性偏弱
projects.summary_en: A well-engineered local AI CRM framework with strong extensibility but weaker deployment reproducibility
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合本地优先团队，部署前需强化锁文件与跨平台验证
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for local-first teams after strengthening lockfiles and cross-platform validation
highlights_zh: TypeScript模块化结构并提供CLI、Web运行时、插件、技能与扩展构建链路
具备类型感知Lint、格式检查、单元测试、发布流水线和npm自动发布机制
highlights_en: Modular TypeScript architecture with CLI, web runtime, plugin, skill, and extension build pipelines
Type-aware linting, formatting checks, unit tests, release workflows, and automated npm publishing
concerns_zh: 锁文件被忽略且发布使用非冻结安装，削弱构建复现性和供应链确定性
部署脚本明显依赖bash、launchd和手工进程管理，Windows支持与故障恢复能力有限
concerns_en: The lockfile is ignored and releases use non-frozen installs, reducing reproducibility and supply-chain determinism
Deployment relies heavily on bash, launchd, and manual process management, limiting Windows support and failure recovery

projects.name: selfhost-ai
projects.description: One-command installer for a self-hosted AI stack on your own server: n8n, Ollama, Open WebUI, OpenClaw, Dify, Flowise, Supabase, ComfyUI, Qdrant & 30+ tools. Docker Compose, automatic HTTPS via Caddy, built-in monitoring. Free Zapier/Make alternative.
projects.summary_zh: 模块化程度较高的 Ubuntu 专属自托管 AI 部署工具，生产能力较强但缺少 CI 支撑
projects.summary_en: A well-structured Ubuntu-specific AI stack installer with strong operational features but limited CI support
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合固定 Ubuntu 环境的个人与小团队生产部署
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for personal and small-team deployments on a fixed Ubuntu environment
highlights_zh: 按编号脚本拆分安装流程，并提供共享工具库、诊断与更新命令
通过 Compose profiles、共享密钥、Caddy 认证及自动 HTTPS 强化服务治理
highlights_en: Modular numbered installation scripts with shared utilities, diagnostics, and update commands
Uses Compose profiles, shared secrets, Caddy authentication, and automatic HTTPS for service governance
concerns_zh: 项目无 CI/CD，Shell 脚本和大量外部服务变更缺少自动化回归验证
安装流程依赖 sudo、apt、Ubuntu 24.04 与 systemd，跨平台和跨发行版复用能力有限
concerns_en: No CI/CD means extensive Shell logic and external-service changes lack automated regression validation
The installer depends on sudo, apt, Ubuntu 24.04, and systemd, limiting cross-platform reuse

projects.name: Canopy
projects.description: A local-first, encrypted Slack/Discord alternative built for the agentic era. AI agents, such as openclaw, join channels, receive tasks, and coordinate on equal footing with humans — over a serverless P2P mesh.
projects.summary_zh: 面向人类与智能体的本地优先协作平台 | 可扩展但仍处早期阶段
projects.summary_en: Local-first collaboration platform for humans and agents | Extensible but still early-stage
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合试点，生产部署前补充测试与安全审计
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for pilots; add tests and security review before production
highlights_zh: 提供REST API、MCP及模块化运行时，具备较强的智能体集成扩展能力
包含多版本CI、非root Docker镜像、依赖分组与类型检查配置，工程化基础较完整
highlights_en: Provides REST, MCP, and a modular runtime with strong agent-integration extensibility
Includes multi-version CI, a non-root Docker image, dependency groups, and type-checking configuration
concerns_zh: 项目仍标记为Alpha且README明确提示存在稳定性风险，贡献者规模也较小
CI目前仅执行编译、导入和模板检查，未运行pytest、flake8、mypy及安全扫描
concerns_en: The project remains Alpha with explicitly documented stability risks and a small contributor base
CI currently omits pytest, flake8, mypy, and security scanning despite defining those tools

projects.name: continue
projects.description: open-source coding agent
projects.summary_zh: 跨平台成熟编码助手 | 适合参考与二次开发但已停止维护
projects.summary_en: Mature cross-platform coding agent suited for reference and forks, but no longer maintained
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合参考与二次开发，不宜作为长期生产依赖
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for reference and forks, but not as a long-term production dependency
highlights_zh: CLI、VS Code与JetBrains多端覆盖，Node 18至24及三大系统持续测试
提供Agent发现与执行机制，并具备格式化、类型检查、lint及分层CI流程
highlights_en: Supports CLI, VS Code, and JetBrains, with CI coverage across Node 18-24 and three major operating systems
Provides agent discovery and execution alongside formatting, type checking, linting, and layered CI
concerns_zh: 仓库已明确停止主动维护并设为只读，长期依赖与安全修复存在风险
自动修复失败测试的流程被永久禁用，Windows端E2E测试亦被跳过
部分GitHub Action仅固定到主版本标签，供应链版本锁定仍可加强
concerns_en: The repository is explicitly archived and read-only, creating long-term dependency and security risk
The failed-test auto-fix workflow is permanently disabled, and Windows E2E tests are skipped
Several GitHub Actions are pinned only to major version tags rather than immutable commits

projects.name: KKTerm
projects.description: Super-tool for vibe coders & system admins — terminals, SSH, SFTP, RDP/VNC, dashboards, install helpers, and a built-in AI assistant.
projects.summary_zh: 功能覆盖广的跨平台运维桌面工作台 | 扩展与发布基础良好
projects.summary_en: Feature-rich cross-platform operations desktop with strong extensibility and release practices
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合多协议运维，建议先审计连接安全与AI权限
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for multi-protocol operations; audit connection security and AI permissions first
highlights_zh: 统一支持终端、SSH/SFTP、RDP/VNC、文件与IT运维工作流
提供MCP、Assistant Skills及隔离权限的.kkmod自定义模块机制
highlights_en: Unifies terminals, SSH/SFTP, RDP/VNC, file management, and IT operations workflows
Provides MCP, reusable assistant skills, and permission-gated isolated .kkmod modules
concerns_zh: 样本仅包含多语言README，缺少核心TypeScript、Rust实现及自动化测试代码证据
项目功能面与协议种类较广，连接异常处理和敏感凭据安全仍需专项验证
concerns_en: The sample contains only localized READMEs, with no core TypeScript, Rust, or automated-test implementation evidence
The broad protocol and feature surface requires targeted validation of failure handling and credential security

projects.name: formax
projects.description: Terminal-first AI assistant for software engineering tasks (inspired by Claude Code v2.0.67)
projects.summary_zh: 多端共享语义内核的实验级 AI 编程助手｜架构清晰但生产成熟度不足
projects.summary_en: Experimental AI coding assistant with a shared multi-client semantic core, but insufficient production maturity
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合学习研究，暂不建议作为生产主力
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for research and experimentation, but not yet a production-first choice
highlights_zh: TUI、JSON-RPC 与 Web 端共享统一语义层，模块边界通过自动脚本持续校验
具备类型检查、单元测试、覆盖率门禁、契约文档及跨端一致性治理体系
highlights_en: TUI, JSON-RPC, and Web clients share a unified semantic layer with automated boundary checks
Comprehensive type checking, tests, coverage gates, contracts, and cross-client consistency governance
concerns_zh: 项目仍处于 Beta，WebFetch、WebSearch、hooks 与 MCP 等关键能力存在缺口或未实现
仅一位贡献者且无正式发布记录，CI 使用浮动的 Bun latest，供应链与长期维护风险较高
concerns_en: The project remains beta, with gaps or missing support in WebFetch, WebSearch, hooks, and MCP
A single contributor, no formal release history, and a floating Bun latest version increase supply-chain and long-term maintenance risk

projects.name: OpenCray
projects.description: openclaw小龙虾机器人：openclaw中文版！接入国产生态：钉钉、QQ、微信、国产大模型！你专属的个人AI助手。任何操作系统，任何平台。龙虾的方式!
projects.summary_zh: 生产级多平台 AI 助手基础设施 | 构建可靠且扩展灵活
projects.summary_en: Production-grade multi-platform AI assistant infrastructure with reliable builds and flexible extensibility
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合生产部署，建议先验证原生依赖兼容性
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for production after validating native dependency compatibility
highlights_zh: 多阶段构建、固定基础镜像摘要并缓存依赖，显著提升构建可复现性
CI 权限收敛、并发控制、任务超时及失败重试机制完善
通过可选扩展依赖、插件目录和跨架构降级支持灵活集成
highlights_en: Multi-stage builds, pinned base-image digests, and dependency caching improve reproducibility
CI uses least-privilege permissions, concurrency control, timeouts, and retries
Optional extension dependencies, plugin directories, and architecture fallbacks enable flexible integration
concerns_zh: Bun、pnpm及Homebrew通过远程脚本安装，工具链版本未完全锁定
Matrix原生绑定可能造成部分CPU架构构建失败
可见静态检查仅覆盖Python技能，缺少TypeScript核心源码的完整质量门禁证据
concerns_en: Bun, pnpm, and Homebrew are installed from remote scripts without fully pinned toolchain versions
The Matrix native binding may prevent builds on some CPU architectures
Visible linting covers Python skills only, with insufficient evidence of comprehensive TypeScript quality gates

projects.name: QVerisBot
projects.description: Your own professional personal AI assistant. Any OS. Any Platform. The lobster way. 🦞
projects.summary_zh: 跨平台插件化个人AI助手 | 工程化较完整但供应链门禁不足
projects.summary_en: Cross-platform plugin-based personal AI assistant with solid engineering but weak supply-chain gates
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合PoC，生产部署前补强供应链与CI策略
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for PoC; strengthen supply-chain controls and CI before production deployment
highlights_zh: 采用多阶段构建、依赖锁定、缓存挂载及固定镜像摘要，容器化工程实践成熟
通过可选扩展目录与构建参数支持插件化和部署变体，扩展能力突出
highlights_en: Mature container practices with multi-stage builds, frozen dependencies, build caches, and pinned image digests
Strong extensibility through optional plugin directories and parameterized build variants
concerns_zh: Bun和Homebrew通过未固定版本的远程脚本安装，且A2UI构建失败会被静默替换为空实现
CodeQL仅支持手动触发，GitHub Actions多使用版本标签而非提交SHA固定，供应链与持续审计存在缺口
concerns_en: Bun and Homebrew are installed through unpinned remote scripts, while failed A2UI builds are silently replaced with empty stubs
CodeQL is manual-only, and GitHub Actions generally use version tags rather than commit SHAs, leaving supply-chain and continuous-audit gaps

projects.name: poco-claw
projects.description: A more beautiful and easier-to-use alternative to OpenClaw. It features a nicer Web UI, built-in IM support, a sandboxed runtime and channel-based team collaboration. Under the hood, it is powered by a Claude Code–based agent.
projects.summary_zh: 功能导向的多端 Agent 平台 | 扩展性突出、测试基线不足
projects.summary_en: Feature-rich multi-channel agent platform with strong extensibility but limited test evidence
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合积极试点，生产部署前补齐自动化测试
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for trials; add comprehensive automated tests before production use
highlights_zh: 后端、执行器与执行器管理器模块边界清晰，并配置 Ruff、Pyrefly、ESLint 和 Prettier 多层静态检查
支持 MCP、Skills、预设、IM 渠道及前后端服务化扩展，Docker 与固定运行时版本降低部署门槛
highlights_en: Clear separation across backend, executor, and executor manager services with layered Ruff, Pyrefly, ESLint, and Prettier checks
MCP, Skills, presets, IM channels, and service-based extension points are supported, while Docker and pinned runtimes simplify deployment
concerns_zh: 所给样本未展示单元、集成、端到端或安全回归测试，无法验证沙箱隔离、任务恢复和并发执行等关键能力
根 pyproject.toml 未声明运行依赖且缺少标准打包配置，Python 3.12、Node 20 与 pnpm 9 仍形成较高环境约束
concerns_en: The supplied sample shows no unit, integration, end-to-end, or security regression tests, leaving sandbox isolation, task recovery, and concurrent execution unverified
The root pyproject.toml declares no runtime dependencies and lacks conventional packaging metadata, while Python 3.12, Node 20, and pnpm 9 impose relatively strict environment requirements

projects.name: Kai
projects.description: OpenClaw alternative in your pocket
projects.summary_zh: 跨平台开源AI助手 | 工程化完善但源码证据有限
projects.summary_en: Cross-platform open-source AI assistant with solid engineering but limited source-level evidence
projects.recommendation_zh: 可考虑采用，建议先审计核心源码与安全边界
projects.recommendation_en: Consider adopting after auditing core code and security boundaries
highlights_zh: 覆盖Android、iOS、Web及主流桌面平台
具备测试、格式化、截图回归和多平台发布流水线
highlights_en: Supports Android, iOS, Web, and major desktop platforms
Includes tests, formatting, screenshot regression, and multi-platform release pipelines
concerns_zh: 样本未包含核心Kotlin源码，无法验证架构、错误处理与安全实现
部分CI依赖使用可变版本标签，发布脚本存在直接修改远程仓库等维护风险
concerns_en: Core Kotlin sources are absent, preventing verification of architecture, error handling, and security
Some CI dependencies use mutable version tags, while release scripts directly mutate remote repositories

projects.name: GoGogot
projects.description: Lightweight self-hosted AI agent. Open-source OpenClaw alternative in Go.
projects.summary_zh: 轻量自托管AI代理 | 插件扩展突出但工程保障偏弱
projects.summary_en: Lightweight self-hosted AI agent with strong extensibility but limited engineering assurance
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合个人试用，生产部署前需补CI与测试
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for personal trials; add CI and tests before production
highlights_zh: 单二进制并支持amd64与arm64，部署和跨平台能力较强
以Go接口和脚本插件解耦模型、通道与渲染层，扩展路径清晰
highlights_en: Single binary with amd64 and arm64 support simplifies deployment and portability
Go interfaces and script plugins cleanly decouple models, channels, and rendering
concerns_zh: 仓库无CI/CD，且仅一名贡献者，版本与质量门禁存在单点风险
智能体具备执行Shell和读写文件能力，虽声明核心鉴权，但缺少可见的自动化安全测试
concerns_en: The repository has no CI/CD and only one contributor, creating release and quality-gate risks
Although owner authentication is documented, the agent's shell and file capabilities lack visible automated security tests

projects.name: agav
projects.description: Terminal-native AI coding assistant for real repositories. Inspect code, edit files, run tests, and verify changes from the CLI.
projects.summary_zh: 功能丰富的终端原生AI编码代理 | 扩展性优秀但仍处于Beta阶段
projects.summary_en: Feature-rich terminal-native AI coding agent with strong extensibility but beta-stage maturity
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合试用与二次开发，核心场景建议谨慎评估
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for trials and extensions, with caution for core workflows
highlights_zh: TypeScript类型检查、Vitest测试、覆盖率脚本与CI配置较完整
支持多模型提供商、MCP、技能与智能体，具备较强扩展基础
提供跨平台安装方式、自包含二进制及非交互式自动化接口
highlights_en: Comprehensive TypeScript checks, Vitest tests, coverage scripts, and CI configuration
Strong extension foundations through multi-provider, MCP, skills, and agent support
Cross-platform installation, self-contained binaries, and non-interactive automation
concerns_zh: 项目仍标注为Experimental Beta，接口和功能存在破坏性变更风险
自动化工作流存在模型输出提示注入、禁用沙箱及直接提交代码的信任边界风险
concerns_en: The project remains an experimental beta with breaking-change risk
Automation workflows expose trust-boundary risks through prompt injection, disabled sandboxing, and direct code commits

projects.name: mimiclaw
projects.description: MimiClaw: Personal Agent on a $5 chip. No OS(Linux). No Node.js. No Mac mini. No Raspberry Pi. No VPS. Hardware agents OS. On device Muse.
projects.summary_zh: 轻量级边缘AI代理 | 文档完善但验证与安全基线不足
projects.summary_en: Lightweight edge AI agent with strong documentation but limited verification and security hardening
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合原型验证，生产部署前需补测试与密钥治理
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for prototyping; add tests and secret governance before production
highlights_zh: 纯C运行于ESP32-S3，无需Linux或Node.js，资源占用与部署成本低
提供Ubuntu与macOS构建脚本、多语言文档及CI发布流程
highlights_en: Pure C on ESP32-S3 eliminates Linux and Node.js while minimizing resource and deployment overhead
Includes Ubuntu and macOS build scripts, multilingual documentation, and CI-based releases
concerns_zh: 源码样本仅含文档与构建配置，缺少核心C实现，无法验证内存、安全及错误处理质量
CI目前只执行编译且无自动化测试、静态分析和故障注入验证
API密钥与WiFi密码支持编译期写入头文件，存在固件泄露与版本库误提交风险
发布流程固定16MB Flash布局且缺少设备矩阵、升级回滚和长期兼容测试
concerns_en: The sample contains only documentation and build configuration, so core C memory safety, error handling, and security cannot be verified
CI only compiles the firmware and lacks automated tests, static analysis, and fault-injection validation
Compile-time API keys and WiFi credentials in headers create firmware disclosure and accidental repository commit risks
The release flow assumes a fixed 16MB flash layout without device-matrix, upgrade rollback, or long-term compatibility testing

projects.name: autobot
projects.description: Ultra-efficient personal AI assistant powered by Crystal
projects.summary_zh: 轻量高效的个人AI助手 | 多平台部署与插件扩展基线
projects.summary_en: Lightweight personal AI assistant with a solid multi-platform and extensible foundation
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合个人场景，生产使用前需强化供应链与安全测试
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for personal use; strengthen supply-chain controls and security testing before production
highlights_zh: CI覆盖格式检查、Ameba静态检查、测试及静态构建，发布包含版本一致性校验
支持Linux amd64/arm64、macOS ARM64与Docker部署，并通过多阶段构建保持镜像轻量
highlights_en: CI covers formatting, Ameba linting, tests, and static builds, with release-version verification
Supports Linux amd64/arm64, macOS ARM64, and Docker while retaining a minimal runtime image
concerns_zh: 构建镜像、文档工具及部分发布参数未固定版本，供应链可复现性不足
提供的样本未展示核心实现，无法验证沙箱、凭据脱敏、故障恢复和测试覆盖的真实质量
concerns_en: Build images, documentation tools, and some release flags are not version-pinned, reducing reproducibility
The sample omits core implementation, preventing verification of sandboxing, credential sanitization, recovery, and test coverage

projects.name: pickle-bot
projects.description: Your own AI assistant, speak like a cat.
projects.summary_zh: 模块化个人AI助手 | 扩展能力突出但生产成熟度有限
projects.summary_en: Modular personal AI assistant with strong extensibility but limited production maturity
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合个人试验与二次开发，暂不建议直接用于关键生产环境
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for personal use and extension, but not yet recommended for critical production workloads
highlights_zh: 支持多智能体、技能扩展、定时任务及多平台接入
具备测试、类型检查、格式化工具及 Docker 交付链路
highlights_en: Supports multi-agent workflows, extensible skills, scheduling, and multiple platforms
Includes testing, type checking, formatting, and Docker delivery workflows
concerns_zh: 仅测试 Python 3.13 且依赖较新，跨版本兼容性缺少验证
发布流程直接引用 master 动作，缺少依赖锁定审计与更完整的安全检查
concerns_en: Only Python 3.13 is tested, leaving cross-version compatibility unverified
The release workflow references a master branch action and lacks stronger dependency and security auditing

projects.name: codebase-argus
projects.description: Multi-agent codebase review for PRs, CI, and downstream fork syncs.
projects.summary_zh: 多模型代码审查与下游同步工具 | 工程质量良好但维护集中
projects.summary_en: Multi-provider code review and fork-sync tooling with solid engineering basics but maintainer concentration
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合试用与集成，生产采用需补充安全评估
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for trials and integration; assess security before production use
highlights_zh: CI 串联依赖安装、ESLint、Vitest 与生产构建，质量门禁完整
支持确定性审查及多种模型提供商，并保留单个提供商失败结果
highlights_en: CI combines dependency installation, ESLint, Vitest, and a production build
Supports deterministic review and multiple model providers while retaining individual provider failures
concerns_zh: 项目仅一名贡献者且发布次数较少，长期维护与知识分散风险较高
样本未展示测试用例、错误处理实现及依赖安全扫描，生产可靠性仍需验证
concerns_en: A single contributor and limited release history create maintainer concentration risk
The sample does not expose test cases, error-handling implementation, or dependency security scanning, leaving production reliability unverified

projects.name: claude-code.nvim
projects.description: Seamless integration between Claude Code AI assistant and Neovim
projects.summary_zh: 功能完整的 Neovim AI 集成插件 | 工程化良好但跨平台验证不足
projects.summary_en: A feature-complete Neovim AI integration plugin with solid engineering but limited cross-platform validation
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合个人与团队试用，生产使用前建议补充跨平台测试
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for individual and team trials; add cross-platform testing before production use
highlights_zh: 模块化结构、配置校验与 LuaCATS 类型注解提升可维护性
具备外部文件实时刷新、Git 根目录识别及浮动窗口等完整功能
highlights_en: Modular structure, configuration validation, and LuaCATS annotations improve maintainability
Provides external-file refresh, Git root detection, floating windows, and other mature features
concerns_zh: CI 仅覆盖 Ubuntu，Neovim 0.7、stable 与 nightly 不能替代 macOS 和 Windows 验证
依赖 Claude CLI 与 plenary.nvim，部分依赖更新工作流仅生成报告而未自动升级
concerns_en: CI covers only Ubuntu; Neovim 0.7, stable, and nightly do not replace macOS and Windows validation
It depends on the Claude CLI and plenary.nvim, while some dependency-update workflows only generate reports

projects.name: ocode
projects.description: OCode is a sophisticated terminal-native AI coding assistant that provides deep codebase intelligence and autonomous task execution
projects.summary_zh: 本地模型驱动的终端 AI 助手 | 工程化基础完善但发布链路存疑
projects.summary_en: Terminal AI assistant for local models with solid engineering foundations but release-pipeline gaps
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合试点，修复发布与安全门禁后再生产使用
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for pilots; fix release and security gates before production use
highlights_zh: 配置了跨平台、多 Python 版本测试矩阵及格式、类型和安全检查
通过 MCP 与专用工具层支持扩展，并提供非 root 容器运行方式
highlights_en: Uses cross-platform multi-version tests with formatting, typing, and security checks
Provides an extensible MCP tool layer and a non-root container runtime
concerns_zh: 发布工作流以可复用工作流方式调用未声明 workflow_call 的 CI，可能无法执行
Bandit、依赖漏洞检查及快速 PR 检查均不阻断流水线，安全门禁偏弱
concerns_en: The release job invokes CI as a reusable workflow although workflow_call is not declared
Bandit, dependency scanning, and quick PR checks are non-blocking, weakening quality gates

projects.name: tmux-file-picker
projects.description: A fuzzy file picker in a tmux popup for selecting files with terminal-based AI coding assistants
projects.summary_zh: 轻量实用的 tmux 文件选择器 | 依赖简洁但测试与 CI 缺失
projects.summary_en: A lightweight, practical tmux file picker with clean dependencies but limited test automation
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合个人开发者试用，团队使用前建议补充测试与 CI
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for individual use; add tests and CI before team adoption
highlights_zh: 严格模式、数组及路径引用处理清晰，支持多选与目录模式
对 fd/fdfind、tree、bat、zoxide 等依赖提供可选降级
highlights_en: Clear strict-mode and array handling with quoting and multi-select support
Graceful handling of optional dependencies such as fd, tree, bat, and zoxide
concerns_zh: 缺少自动化测试和 CI，回归风险主要依赖人工验证
部分发送按键路径未统一使用字面量模式，特殊文件名可能产生异常
未显式检查 fzf 依赖，命令缺失时错误信息不够友好
concerns_en: No automated tests or CI, leaving regression risk to manual verification
Some key-sending paths do not consistently use literal mode, risking odd behavior for special filenames
The fzf dependency is not checked explicitly, resulting in less helpful failure output

projects.name: context-optimizer-mcp-server
projects.description: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that provides context optimization tools for AI coding assistants including GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, Claude Desktop, and other MCP-compatible assistants enabling them to extract targeted information rather than processing large terminal outputs and files wasting their context.
projects.summary_zh: 功能完整的多模型MCP上下文优化工具 | 工程化尚需源码验证
projects.summary_en: Feature-rich multi-LLM MCP context optimizer with solid engineering foundations
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合试用，敏感环境需先审计命令执行边界
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for trials; audit command execution boundaries before sensitive use
highlights_zh: TypeScript构建、自动化测试与双工作流CI覆盖发布和PR验证
兼容Node 18以上并支持Gemini、Claude、OpenAI及Exa研究能力
highlights_en: TypeScript build, automated tests, and dual CI workflows cover publishing and PR validation
Supports Node 18+, Gemini, Claude, OpenAI, and Exa-backed research workflows
concerns_zh: 源码样本未包含核心TypeScript实现，路径校验、命令过滤和会话管理无法核验
项目仅一名贡献者，存在维护与发布单点风险
缺少lint、格式化、依赖审计及覆盖率门槛，发布流程主要依赖构建和测试
concerns_en: Core TypeScript implementation is absent from the sample, so path validation, command filtering, and session handling cannot be verified
A single contributor creates maintenance and release continuity risk
No lint, formatting, dependency-audit, or coverage gates are configured; publishing relies mainly on build and tests

projects.name: tinyagi
projects.description: TinyAGI is the agent teams orchestrator for One Person Company. (fka TinyClaw)
projects.summary_zh: 实验型模块化多智能体编排器 | 可复现构建仍待加强
projects.summary_en: Experimental modular multi-agent orchestrator with reproducibility gaps
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合技术验证，生产部署前补齐测试与依赖锁定
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for trials; add tests and dependency locking before production
highlights_zh: TypeScript 工作区按核心、团队、通道、服务端与可视化器清晰分包
插件机制、多提供商及多通道架构具备良好扩展潜力
highlights_en: Clear TypeScript workspace separation across core, teams, channels, server, and visualizer packages
Plugin, provider, and channel abstractions offer strong extension potential
concerns_zh: 项目忽略 package-lock.json 且发布流程使用 npm install，依赖构建不可复现
未提供测试、检查脚本或覆盖率配置，Docker 中关键 CLI 与浏览器安装失败会被静默忽略
concerns_en: The ignored package-lock.json and npm install release flow make dependency resolution non-reproducible
No test, lint, or coverage scripts are evident, while critical Docker CLI and browser installation failures are silently ignored

projects.name: lettabot
projects.description: Archived - has been replaced by Letta Code channels/schedules!
projects.summary_zh: 工程化完善的多渠道 TypeScript 助手，但项目已归档且停止维护
projects.summary_en: Well-engineered multi-channel TypeScript assistant, but the project is archived and unmaintained
projects.recommendation_zh: 不建议新项目采用，建议迁移Letta Code
projects.recommendation_en: Avoid for new projects; migrate to Letta Code
highlights_zh: 覆盖 Telegram、Slack、Discord、WhatsApp、Signal 与 Bluesky，渠道扩展能力较强
提供单元测试、E2E 测试、Docker 构建和发布流水线，具备完整 CI/CD 质量门禁
highlights_en: Supports Telegram, Slack, Discord, WhatsApp, Signal, and Bluesky with strong channel extensibility
Includes unit tests, E2E tests, Docker builds, and release pipelines with solid CI/CD gates
concerns_zh: README 明确声明项目已弃用且不再积极维护，新功能和修复已转移至 Letta Code
依赖 Bash、signal-cli、WhatsApp 原生组件及多种平台相关依赖，跨环境部署复杂度较高
可选依赖数量较多且原生编译工具链较重，安装稳定性和平台兼容性存在风险
concerns_en: The README explicitly marks the project as deprecated and no longer actively maintained
Reliance on Bash, signal-cli, native WhatsApp components, and platform-specific packages complicates deployment
Numerous optional and native dependencies increase installation stability and cross-platform compatibility risks

projects.name: openclaw-android-assistant
projects.description: 🦞 AnyClaw — OpenClaw + Codex + Claude Code on Android. Three AI agents in one APK. Claw Code / OpenClaude running in full Linux. No root. No server. No PC.
projects.summary_zh: 集成式移动端多智能体项目，工程化基础较好但发布流程与上游同步治理存在风险
projects.summary_en: An integrated mobile multi-agent project with solid engineering foundations but risky release and upstream-sync processes
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合尝鲜，发布前强化构建与冲突治理
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for trials; harden builds and conflict governance before production release
highlights_zh: Docker 多阶段构建并固定基础镜像摘要，支持可复现构建
插件选择、嵌入式 Linux 与多智能体集成具备较强扩展能力
highlights_en: Multi-stage Docker builds with digest-pinned base images support reproducibility
Plugin selection, embedded Linux, and multi-agent integration provide strong extensibility
concerns_zh: APK 工作流使用 npm ci 失败后回退 npm install，并以 debug APK 发布
上游同步采用强制推送和自动解决冲突策略，失败处理与供应链一致性不足
concerns_en: The APK workflow falls back to npm install and publishes a debug-signed APK
Upstream synchronization relies on force pushes and automatic conflict resolution with weak failure handling and supply-chain consistency

projects.name: jrdev
projects.description: JrDev is a free open-source AI developer assistant for the terminal. It provides CLI/TUI interfaces to interact with LLMs for code generation, project context management, and Git operations.
projects.summary_zh: 模块化终端 AI 编程助手 | 早期访问阶段
projects.summary_en: Modular terminal AI coding assistant with a solid extensibility foundation but early-access reliability
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合早期试用，暂不建议直接用于生产代码修改
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for early trials, but not yet recommended for production code changes
highlights_zh: 核心、命令、代理、服务、提示词与界面分层清晰，模块边界明确
支持多模型配置与角色路由，便于扩展模型和任务流程
highlights_en: Clear separation across core, commands, agents, services, prompts, and UI layers
Configurable multi-model profiles and role-based routing support flexible expansion
concerns_zh: 项目明确处于早期访问阶段，接口与行为可能频繁破坏性变更
CI未设置覆盖率阈值，且未生成所声明上传的junit.xml测试报告
环境变量示例与文档所描述的模型配置范围不完全一致
缺少针对异常处理、API失败及文件写入回滚的可见保障
concerns_en: The project is explicitly early-access and may introduce breaking changes
CI enforces no coverage threshold and does not generate the junit.xml report it attempts to upload
The environment template does not fully reflect the model configuration described in the documentation
Visible safeguards for API failures, exception handling, and write rollback are limited

projects.name: subzeroclaw
projects.description: An agent small enough to run anywhere. A minimal agentic runtime in C — ~380 lines, 54KB binary, ~2MB RAM. A skill file + an LLM + a shell loop, no framework.
projects.summary_zh: 轻量透明的边缘智能体运行时 | 结构简洁但执行安全与长期治理不足
projects.summary_en: A lightweight, transparent edge-agent runtime with a simple structure but significant execution-safety and long-term governance gaps
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合受控实验环境，不建议直接用于生产或高权限主机
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for controlled experiments; avoid direct deployment in production or on high-privilege hosts
highlights_zh: 单文件C11实现配合严格编译告警，构建流程简单且可复现
提供单元测试、环回集成测试与GitHub Actions持续集成
highlights_en: A compact C11 implementation with strict compiler warnings, a simple build, and reproducible dependency fallback
Includes unit tests, loopback integration tests, and GitHub Actions continuous integration
concerns_zh: 模型输出可无确认执行任意Shell命令，缺少沙箱、权限隔离与破坏性操作防护
核心能力依赖外部路由服务、curl及可选系统libcjson，独立运行模式存在上下文增长和降级限制
concerns_en: Model output can execute arbitrary shell commands without confirmation, sandboxing, permission isolation, or destructive-operation safeguards
Core behavior depends on an external router, curl, and optionally system libcjson, while standalone mode has context-growth and degradation limitations

projects.name: OpenDesign
projects.description: Open-source Canva alternative — design editor for social media graphics. Fabric.js + Preact + Hono + SQLite. Part of the OpenClaw ecosystem.
projects.summary_zh: 功能完整的自托管设计编辑器 | 扩展性较好但工程安全基线不足
projects.summary_en: A feature-rich self-hosted design editor with solid extensibility but limited engineering and security hardening
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合自托管原型，投产前补齐测试与安全基线
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for self-hosted prototypes; add test and security baselines before production
highlights_zh: 模板字段、品牌套件及REST API形成清晰的自动化扩展路径
TypeScript、Preact、Hono与SQLite组合轻量，MIT许可利于自托管
highlights_en: Template fields, brand kits, and REST APIs provide a clear automation path
The TypeScript, Preact, Hono, and SQLite stack is lightweight and self-hostable
concerns_zh: 测试仅覆盖fields和fonts两个模块，且CI工作流未执行测试、类型检查或构建
未见认证授权、上传内容校验、数据库迁移及生产安全策略的代码证据
concerns_en: Tests cover only the fields and fonts modules, while CI does not run tests, type checks, or builds
The provided code shows no evidence of authentication, authorization, upload validation, database migrations, or production security controls

projects.name: awesome-agent-skills
projects.description: A curated collection of 1000+ agent skills from official dev teams and the community, compatible with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, and more.
projects.summary_zh: 轻量清晰的跨平台技能目录 | 自动化质量保障缺失
projects.summary_en: A lightweight, portable cross-agent skill directory with weak automated quality controls
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合发现技能，但批量引入前需自行审计与验证
projects.recommendation_en: Great for discovery, but validate and audit skills before bulk adoption
highlights_zh: 采用外链聚合架构，各技能独立维护，降低仓库耦合并提升跨工具可移植性
贡献规范明确，规定分类、命名、描述长度及成熟度要求
highlights_en: Uses an external-link aggregation model, reducing coupling and improving cross-agent portability
Provides clear contribution rules covering categorization, naming, description length, and maturity
concerns_zh: 无 CI/CD 与自动化链接校验，失效或恶意外链难以及时发现
下载脚本和核心 README 未包含在源码样本中，关键实现质量无法验证
concerns_en: No CI/CD or automated link validation, making broken or malicious links difficult to detect promptly
The download script and core README are absent from the sample, preventing verification of key implementation quality

projects.name: oli
projects.description: A simple, fast terminal based AI coding assistant
projects.summary_zh: 多模型终端编码助手 | 工程化完善但仍处于早期阶段
projects.summary_en: Multi-provider terminal coding assistant with solid engineering foundations but early-stage maturity
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合早期试用，暂不建议用于关键生产环境
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for early trials, but not yet recommended for critical production use
highlights_zh: Rust 后端与 React/Ink 前端职责分离，支持云端及本地多模型提供商
配置了格式检查、Clippy、类型构建、覆盖率、基准测试和发布流水线
highlights_en: Clear Rust backend and React/Ink frontend separation with multiple cloud and local model providers
Includes formatting, Clippy, type checking, coverage, benchmarking, and publishing workflows
concerns_zh: 项目明确处于早期阶段，命令执行、错误恢复及工具调用边界仍需更多验证
前端测试脚本直接返回失败，且样本中未见命令执行沙箱与敏感信息脱敏机制
依赖 Node.js 23.10、Ollama及 Unix 平台支持，部署环境要求偏高
concerns_en: The project explicitly remains early-stage, requiring more validation around command execution, recovery, and tool-call boundaries
The frontend test script always fails, and no command sandbox or sensitive-data redaction mechanism is evident in the sample
Reliance on Node.js 23.10, Ollama, and Unix platforms raises the deployment baseline

projects.name: trinity-claw
projects.description: A self-hosted AI agent that thinks, acts, and improves itself – all running privately on your own machine. Browses the web, writes and executes code, manages files, sends emails, monitors URLs, builds websites, and learns from every interaction.
projects.summary_zh: 本地优先的自托管智能体 | 扩展性较强但安全与发布基线有限
projects.summary_en: Local-first self-hosted AI agent with strong extensibility but limited security and release maturity
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合私有网络试用，公网部署前需加固
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for private-network trials; harden before public deployment
highlights_zh: 核心技能、动态技能与配置分层，扩展接口清晰
提供容器化及 macOS 原生 Ollama 部署方案
highlights_en: Clear separation of core skills, dynamic skills, and configuration
Supports containerized and native macOS Ollama deployment
concerns_zh: API缺少多用户认证和限流，且支持任意代码执行
依赖镜像未固定版本，数据库与密钥存在弱默认值
发布版本为零且贡献者单一，CI仅执行强制同步
concerns_en: The API lacks multi-user authentication and rate limiting while permitting arbitrary code execution
Dependency images are not version-pinned, and database credentials use weak defaults
There are no releases, only one contributor, and CI merely force-pushes synchronized content

projects.name: DeepSeek-Reasonix
projects.description: A reliable coding agent for complex software engineering tasks.
projects.summary_zh: 工程化较完整的跨端编码代理，但已停止维护
projects.summary_en: A well-engineered cross-platform coding agent, but no longer maintained
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合研究与二次开发，生产使用需自行维护
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for research and development; fork and maintain for production use
highlights_zh: 具备终端、桌面、浏览器和编辑器等多端接入能力
CI 覆盖测试、类型检查、ACP 一致性与 CodeQL 安全扫描
highlights_en: Supports terminal, desktop, browser, and editor integrations
CI covers tests, type checking, ACP conformance, and CodeQL scanning
concerns_zh: 项目已明确停止维护，后续不再修复缺陷或处理 Issue
提供的样本以文档和 CI 配置为主，核心 Go 实现缺乏直接证据
concerns_en: The project is explicitly unmaintained, with no further fixes or issue triage
The supplied sample mainly contains documentation and CI configuration, with limited direct evidence for the core Go implementation

projects.name: nanoclaw-py
projects.description: Yet another nano alternative to OpenClaw. It can read/write files, execute commands, search the web, and schedule tasks — all in ~500 lines of Python.
projects.summary_zh: 轻量教学型个人智能体 | 扩展友好但生产保障不足
projects.summary_en: Lightweight educational personal agent with extensibility but limited production safeguards
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合学习验证，不宜直接用于高权限生产环境
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for learning and prototypes, not privileged production use
highlights_zh: 基于成熟SDK集成Telegram、Claude、调度与持久化能力
按七个递进课程组织代码，结构清晰且易于理解扩展
highlights_en: Integrates Telegram, Claude, scheduling, and persistence through established SDKs
Organizes functionality into seven progressive lessons that are approachable and extensible
concerns_zh: 具备文件写入、命令执行和网页访问能力，但样本中未见权限隔离、审计、测试及CI防护
依赖Claude Code CLI与Bash环境且Python版本要求较高，跨平台部署能力有限
项目仅一名贡献者、无发布版本与CI/CD，长期维护和供应链稳定性存在风险
concerns_en: File writes, command execution, and web access are enabled without visible permission isolation, auditing, tests, or CI safeguards
Reliance on the Claude Code CLI, Bash, and Python 3.12+ limits cross-platform deployment
A single contributor, no tagged releases, and no CI/CD create long-term maintenance and supply-chain risks

projects.name: hermitclaw
projects.summary_zh: 创意鲜明的本地 AI 助手原型，工程化与安全隔离尚不充分
projects.summary_en: A creative local AI agent prototype with promising extensibility but limited production hardening
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合实验研究，生产环境须隔离部署
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for experiments; isolate thoroughly before production use
highlights_zh: 架构与运行流程文档清晰，依赖精简且支持多种模型提供商
提供记忆、反思、规划和工具调用机制，具备良好的扩展潜力
highlights_en: Clear architecture and lifecycle documentation with a lean dependency set and multiple provider support
Built-in memory, reflection, planning, and tool-calling mechanisms provide strong extension potential
concerns_zh: README 明确承认命令拦截与路径限制并非安全边界，且缺少容器或沙箱实现
无 CI/CD、正式发布和可见测试覆盖，核心源码样本不足以验证异常处理与并发安全
concerns_en: The project explicitly states that command blocking and path restrictions are not a security boundary, while no sandbox implementation is shown
There is no CI/CD, formal release history, or visible test coverage, and the limited source sample prevents verification of error handling and concurrency safety

projects.name: shrew
projects.summary_zh: 轻量模块化命令行智能体 | 原型可用但生产安全基线不足
projects.summary_en: Lightweight modular CLI agent with a production-security baseline still in need
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合实验使用，生产部署前需补强安全与测试
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for experimentation; strengthen security and tests before production use
highlights_zh: 零依赖Go实现并提供Linux与macOS交叉编译
Channel接口与Engine解耦，具备多渠道扩展基础
highlights_en: Zero-dependency Go implementation with Linux and macOS cross-compilation
Channel abstraction decoupled from the Engine for multi-channel expansion
concerns_zh: Shell命令执行缺少沙箱、路径限制、超时与输出上限
HTTP客户端无超时且未使用请求上下文
仓库无CI/CD且当前样本未展示自动化测试
日志会记录消息预览，可能造成敏感信息泄露
concerns_en: Shell execution lacks sandboxing, path restrictions, timeouts, and output limits
The HTTP client has no timeout and does not use request contexts
No CI/CD is configured and the sampled repository shows no automated tests
Message previews are logged and may expose sensitive information

projects.name: lossless-claw-enhanced
projects.description: Fork of Martian-Engineering/lossless-claw with CJK-aware token estimation
projects.summary_zh: 功能完善但已停更弃用的 OpenClaw 上下文管理插件分支
projects.summary_en: A capable but deprecated and unmaintained OpenClaw context-management fork
projects.recommendation_zh: 建议迁移至 upstream，勿用于新部署
projects.recommendation_en: Migrate to upstream and avoid new deployments
highlights_zh: 提供 DAG 层级摘要、持久化消息与相关上下文重建能力
针对 CJK、认证误判、会话轮转和空消息等场景提供测试与修复
具备 CI、Changesets、自动发布及 Docker 部署支持
highlights_en: Provides DAG-based hierarchical summaries, persistent messages, and relevance-based context reconstruction
Includes fixes and tests for CJK handling, false auth detection, session rotation, and empty messages
Offers CI, Changesets, automated publishing, and Docker deployment support
concerns_zh: README 已明确弃用，停留在 0.5.3 且无法兼容当前 OpenClaw
核心依赖使用通配符版本，缺少锁定的兼容性边界
CI 仅运行测试，未执行类型检查、静态检查或发布构建验证
Docker 构建通过 || true 忽略构建失败，并安装全局 latest OpenClaw，可复现性不足
package.json 使用上游包名和仓库地址，存在发布身份及来源混淆风险
concerns_en: The README explicitly marks the fork deprecated; it remains at 0.5.3 and no longer supports current OpenClaw
Core dependencies use wildcard versions with no explicit compatibility boundaries
CI only runs tests and omits type checking, linting, and release-build validation
The Docker build masks failures with || true and installs the latest global OpenClaw, reducing reproducibility
The package metadata uses the upstream package name and repository URL, creating publishing and provenance ambiguity

projects.name: angel-claw
projects.description: Lean. Compatible. Based OpenClaw. Python ❤️ (14k downloads)
projects.summary_zh: 功能丰富的多租户智能体平台原型 | 扩展性较强但工程基线不足
projects.summary_en: Feature-rich multi-tenant agent platform prototype with strong extensibility but weak engineering assurance
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合试点验证，暂不建议核心生产采用
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for pilots, but not yet recommended for core production workloads
highlights_zh: 采用标准 Python 打包、命令入口及可选依赖分组
技能注册、MCP、多模型与多渠道桥接形成清晰扩展边界
highlights_en: Uses standard Python packaging, a CLI entry point, and optional dependency groups
Skill registry, MCP, multi-model support, and channel bridges provide clear extension boundaries
concerns_zh: 未提供实现源码样本，无法验证隔离、加密、沙箱和认证等关键机制
无 CI/CD 且测试配置有限，缺少持续回归与质量门禁证据
未提交锁文件，依赖版本不可复现，且 changelog 与当前依赖声明存在漂移
本地 editable 依赖配置及 systemd/Nginx 部署说明降低了跨环境开箱即用性
concerns_en: No implementation source was provided, so isolation, encryption, sandboxing, and authentication cannot be verified
There is no CI/CD and limited test configuration, with no evidence of continuous regression controls or quality gates
No lockfile is committed, dependency versions are not reproducible, and the changelog appears inconsistent with current dependency declarations
A local editable dependency and systemd/Nginx-centric deployment guidance reduce cross-environment out-of-box usability

projects.name: supaclaw
projects.description: A basic version of OpenClaw but built entirely on Supabase built-in features.
projects.summary_zh: Supabase原生多渠道代理 | 文档完善的早期原型
projects.summary_en: Supabase-native multi-channel agent with well-documented early-stage architecture
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合PoC，生产采用前需补齐CI与测试
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for a PoC; add CI and tests before production use
highlights_zh: 采用持久化队列、重试与幂等语义，架构强调可恢复性
数据库、存储、认证、定时任务和运行时统一使用Supabase原语
highlights_en: Uses a persistent queue with retry and idempotency semantics
Unifies database, storage, auth, scheduling, and runtime on Supabase primitives
concerns_zh: 样本未包含实现代码、测试及CI配置，关键能力无法从源码验证
项目仅两名贡献者、零发布且无CI/CD，发布治理与维护连续性不足
concerns_en: The sample contains no implementation, tests, or CI configuration, so key claims cannot be verified from code
With only two contributors, no releases, and no CI/CD, release governance and maintenance continuity remain weak

projects.name: droidclaw
projects.description: turn old phones into ai agents - give it a goal in plain english. it reads the screen, thinks about what to do, taps and types via adb, and repeats until the job is done.
projects.summary_zh: 模块化多模型 Android 智能体 | 可靠性与工程化仍有提升空间
projects.summary_en: Modular multi-model Android agent with room for stronger reliability and engineering practices
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合实验验证，暂不建议直接用于关键生产任务
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for experiments, not yet recommended for critical production tasks
highlights_zh: 感知、推理、动作执行职责拆分清晰，支持多模型提供商和28类设备动作
内置ADB重试、卡死恢复、视觉降级、元素过滤及多轮历史等韧性机制
highlights_en: Clear separation of perception, reasoning, and execution, with multiple providers and 28 device actions
Includes ADB retries, stuck-loop recovery, vision fallback, element filtering, and multi-turn history
concerns_zh: 依赖Bun与ADB并面向Android，环境可移植性有限，且测试样本仅见临时脚本
环境变量缺少严格解析与边界校验，执行结果主要依赖文本判断，shell动作存在安全风险
项目无CI/CD且忽略锁文件，贡献者数量较少，长期维护与依赖可复现性不足
concerns_en: Relies on Bun, ADB, and Android, limiting portability; visible testing consists mainly of an ad hoc script
Environment parsing lacks strict validation, execution outcomes rely heavily on text matching, and shell actions pose security risks
No CI/CD, lockfiles are ignored, and the small contributor base weakens long-term maintenance and reproducibility

projects.name: atombot
projects.description: A tiny but powerful personal AI assistant 🐙
projects.summary_zh: 轻量多提供商个人助手 | 工程化与可靠性仍待验证
projects.summary_en: Lightweight multi-provider personal assistant with engineering and reliability still unverified
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合个人试验，暂不建议直接生产部署
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for personal trials, but not recommended for immediate production use
highlights_zh: 项目结构按代理、渠道、提供商与调度器分层，扩展边界清晰
支持Python 3.9以上及标准setuptools打包，部署门槛较低
highlights_en: Clear layering across agents, channels, providers, and schedulers
Supports Python 3.9+ with standard setuptools packaging and low deployment overhead
concerns_zh: 缺少源码实现与测试样本，核心功能质量和异常处理无法核验
无CI/CD、无正式发布且仅一名贡献者，项目维护与交付连续性偏弱
concerns_en: Implementation and tests are absent from the sample, preventing verification of core behavior and error handling
No CI/CD or formal releases and only one contributor indicate weak delivery and maintenance continuity

projects.name: babyclaw
projects.description: A lightweight alternative to OpenClaw built on Claude Agent SDK.
projects.summary_zh: 功能完整但架构偏单体的轻量 Telegram 助手，适合个人实验部署
projects.summary_en: A feature-rich lightweight Telegram assistant with a monolithic architecture suited to personal experimentation
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合个人试用，生产部署前需重构与加固
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for personal trials; refactor and harden before production use
highlights_zh: 使用官方 Claude Agent SDK 与 Grammy，核心依赖精简且功能覆盖会话、队列、定时任务和文件传输
具备用户 ID 白名单、消息队列、中断控制和持久化状态等基础运行机制
highlights_en: Uses the official Claude Agent SDK and Grammy with a focused dependency set covering sessions, queues, cron jobs, and file delivery
Includes basic operational safeguards such as user allowlisting, message queueing, interruption, and persisted state
concerns_zh: 核心逻辑集中在单文件且缺少测试、CI、发布版本与多贡献者维护，回归和持续演进风险较高
使用 bypassPermissions 和 dangerously-skip-permissions 指导模型执行命令，缺少细粒度权限隔离与审计机制
自定义环境变量解析、同步文件写入及多处空 catch 会降低异常可观测性，状态写入也缺少原子性保障
concerns_en: Core logic is concentrated in one file without tests, CI, releases, or broad maintainer participation, creating regression and continuity risks
Relies on bypassPermissions and dangerously-skip-permissions for command execution without fine-grained isolation or auditing
Custom environment parsing, synchronous file writes, and several empty catch blocks reduce observability, while state persistence is not atomic

projects.name: cmux
projects.description: Open source Ghostty-based macOS terminal with vertical tabs and notifications for AI coding agents. Built for multitasking, organization, and programmability.
projects.summary_zh: 面向 macOS 的 AI 编程代理终端 | 扩展性强但实现质量待验证
projects.summary_en: macOS terminal for AI coding agents with strong extensibility but limited implementation evidence
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合 macOS 重度用户，核心团队可试点
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for macOS power users; pilot before production adoption
highlights_zh: 提供 CLI、Socket API、自定义命令和浏览器自动化接口
项目活跃度高，具备 CI/CD、多语言文档及持续发布机制
highlights_en: Exposes CLI, socket API, custom commands, and browser automation
Active project with CI/CD, multilingual documentation, and frequent releases
concerns_zh: 源码样本仅为多语言 README，无法核验 Swift 架构、错误处理与测试覆盖
明确面向 macOS 与 Ghostty，跨平台移植能力有限
concerns_en: Samples contain only localized READMEs, so Swift architecture, error handling, and test coverage remain unverified
The explicit macOS and Ghostty dependency substantially limits cross-platform portability

projects.name: Aivy-OS
projects.description: Your own digital life form — local AI companion with persistent memory, IDE workspace, MCP support, and 30+ tools. Companion-first alternative to Hermes Agent / OpenClaw / Claude Code.
projects.summary_zh: 产品文档完整但仅发布闭源二进制，代码质量与可维护性无法验证
projects.summary_en: Well-documented product with closed binary releases, but code quality and maintainability are unverifiable
projects.recommendation_zh: 仅适合Windows个人用户试用，不宜直接用于生产集成
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for Windows individual trials, not direct production integration
highlights_zh: 中英文 README 覆盖功能、安装、系统要求、隐私与版本更新
明确说明本地数据存储、默认本机访问及云端模型数据流向
highlights_en: Bilingual READMEs cover features, installation, requirements, privacy, and releases
Clearly documents local storage, localhost-only access, and cloud-model data flow
concerns_zh: 仓库明确仅包含文档和截图，源码及测试代码缺失，无法审计实现质量
采用专有许可证且仅分发编译后二进制，缺少持续集成和自动化质量门禁
仅支持 Windows 10/11 64 位，跨平台与 Linux/macOS 可移植性弱
项目由单一贡献者维护，存在关键人员与发布连续性风险
concerns_en: The repository intentionally contains only documentation and screenshots, leaving implementation and tests unauditable
A proprietary license with binary-only distribution and no CI/CD limits verification and release assurance
Windows 10/11 64-bit is the only supported platform, limiting portability
Single-contributor maintenance creates key-person and release continuity risk

projects.name: ZeroClaw-Android
projects.description: Run AI agents 24/7 on your Android phone. Native Rust core, 25+ providers (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Groq, DeepSeek,         Ollama), encrypted key storage, plugin browser, Material You UI. Self-hosted alternative to Mac Mini setups. MIT           licensed.
projects.summary_zh: 已归档的高风险实验项目 | 缺少生产维护基线
projects.summary_en: Archived high-risk experiment lacking a production maintenance baseline
projects.recommendation_zh: 不建议用于生产环境
projects.recommendation_en: Avoid production use; only fork for controlled experimentation.
highlights_zh: 公开说明归档原因及代码生成背景
项目定位覆盖多模型提供商与自托管场景
highlights_en: Transparently documents the archiving rationale and AI-generated codebase
Targets multi-provider, self-hosted agent workloads
concerns_zh: 仓库已归档且明确认为现有代码范围过大并存在安全风险；源码样本仅含README、无CI/CD且贡献者仅1人，无法验证实现质量、健壮性、跨平台构建与扩展机制
concerns_en: The repository is archived and explicitly described as unsafe, with scope excessive and an almost entirely AI-generated codebase; the sample contains only a README, while the absence of CI/CD and a single contributor prevents verification of implementation quality, robustness, portability, and extension mechanisms
